scope: Offline constructed replay of the actual browser service; no provider or robot calls
defect: A repeated provider call ID could execute motion twice. Reproduced in same packet, overlapping packets and after a turn boundary; not observed in retained live traces.
change: Session-lifetime IDs claimed before awaits. Duplicate dispatch/response/ack suppressed; original owns its response. Stop can reuse an ordinary ID once; distinct IDs and fresh sessions remain intentional new requests.

validation.independent_review: Final-byte read-only review; no blocking findings; no independent test rerun

limits: Not an HTTP end-to-end idempotency protocol or physical result.
Missing IDs retain previous behavior; no content-based deduplication.
Model intent and natural-language claims still require evidence; no new intent classifier.
